Title: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn values your feedback and reviews it regularly to make timely improvements. By providing clear feedback, you help improve documentation quality and drive changes you want to see. Reach out to our documentation team directly using the Feedback button at the top right corner of every page.

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text: Steps to provide documentation feedback are given below:

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text:
Use the Was this page helpful? prompt that appears at the top right corner of the page.


Click the thumbs-up or thumbs-down button to indicate whether the content was helpful.
The feedback options are displayed as shown below:


Select the reason for your feedback. This field is required.

Enter your comments in the Tell us more section to provide additional details.

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text: Please provide detailed feedback about the content changes you want to see. This helps us respond quickly and prioritize fixes. Do not include sensitive or personal information in your comments.

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text: Click Submit to send the feedback to our documentation team.

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text: Once we receive your feedback, our team will evaluate it and prioritize changes based on urgency and relevance.

Blocks.Section: How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
How to Provide Documentation Feedback to LinkedIn
Blocks.Text: To provide product-related feedback, click Provide product feedback in the feedback prompt. This will redirect you to the LinkedIn Developer Support Portal, where you can submit a ticket directly to our product teams.
